comment: Rules for the flooded hill-town. `contains` is the containment tree for both the exclusive rule (so a coarse `at` a quarter and a fine `at` a site inside it refine one position instead of conflicting) and the transition map (so the adjacency edges are partitioned into one root scope plus one scope per quarter, and a step between a quarter and a site inside it is a crossing that needs no edge). The adjacency predicate declares both leg kinds (`place`), so the map-completeness class can be asked what a place is.
